title: BGFX Renderer & Automation Overhaul
acceptance: BGFX integrated as the primary renderer on Windows, Linux, and macOS with headless submission support; no residual OpenGL entry points remain outside the compatibility shim.
New RHI abstraction encapsulates GPU resources, queue submission, and framebuffer control with deterministic encoder ordering suitable for CLI and automation runs.
CLI render paths (JsonOps, headless batch, automation hooks) drive BGFX views without launching the UI and emit structured render metadata plus deterministic logs.
ImGui/UI layer is ported to the BGFX backend while preserving desktop UX and providing remote status mirroring for automation observers.
Shader toolchain migrated to offline compilation (bgfx shaderc or glslang-based) with reproducible binaries stored under resources/shaders/bin.
Resource ownership for meshes, textures, IBL data, and raytraced outputs updated to backend-agnostic handles with deterministic lifetime management.
Automation contracts documented: CLI verbs, JSON ops, and new IPC hooks expose all render settings (camera, lighting, tone map, AI parameters) required for scripting agents.
Regression suite updated: golden-image comparisons, CLI headless matrix, and performance runs (1080p/4K) prove parity with legacy OpenGL while staying within ±5% frame time budget.
Documentation (CLAUDE.md plus new architecture specs) reflects the BGFX pipeline, CLI-first workflow, deterministic logging guarantees, and upgrade guidance.
current_index.json updated with this module tracked on the critical path once glint_cli_platform_v1 reaches Phase 3.
